notes.title: [Development Update] New Cinematic Control System Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[p][b]\[Development Update] New Cinematic Control System for Animations Coming Soon!

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/39bef2210377cf94fbe20bc0cd9a653ebd586888.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We wanted to share a sneak peek at something we've been cooking up based on your feedback - a new [b]multi-scene animation control system[/b] that we're implementing for more complex cinematic sequences![/p][p][b]How It Works:[/b] As you can see in the preview, this new system allows for seamless navigation through multi-camera angles and different character poses within the same animation sequence. The progression system works like this:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Scenes 1-3[/b]: Viewed and unlocked (available for replay)[/p][/*][*][p]▶️ [b]Scene 4[/b]: Currently viewing[/p][/*][*][p]🔓 [b]Scene 5[/b]: Unlocked but not yet viewed (new content ready!)[/p][/*][*][p]🔒 [b]Scene 6[/b]: Locked (requires progression)[/p][/*][/list][p]This gives you more control over your viewing experience while maintaining the sense of discovery and progression that's core to the game.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/a7ee8b84fd294036d7b5bf79a354a4191ee23a50.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🆕 NEW IN TODAY'S UPDATE - Animation Pacing Control![/b] We've just introduced a new [b]Pacing control[/b] feature to ensure you never miss animations again! You can now choose between:[/p][list][*][p][b]Full (0s)[/b] - No delay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick (1.5s)[/b] - Default setting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cinematic (3.5s)[/b] - Recommended for best experience![/p][/*][*][p][b]Minimum (6s)[/b] - Maximum delay between animations[/p][/*][/list][p]You can find this in the Settings menu under the Pacing section. While Quick is enabled by default, we recommend trying the Cinematic pacing for the intended experience. We've also [b]increased the font size[/b] of all settings labels for better readability![/p][p][b]Quality Updates:[/b] In our commitment to delivering the best experience possible:[/p][list][*][p]We've [b]removed 4 animations[/b] (including some car and zoom sequences) that weren't meeting our quality standards[/p][/*][*][p]Currently [b]reworking 5 animations[/b] to fix eye tracking inconsistencies and improve overall quality[/p][/*][*][p][b]These animation fixes will be patched in within the next few days to a week![/b] 🔧[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify these issues! 🙏[/p][p][b]When Can You Expect This?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pacing Control[/b]: Available NOW in today's update![/p][/*][*][p][b]Animation fixes[/b]: Coming in the next few days to a week[/p][/*][*][p][b]New cinematic control system[/b]: Rolling out around [b]Episode 2 or potentially a bit earlier[/b] if testing goes smoothly[/p][/*][/list][p]What do you think about this new approach to cinematic sequences? Would you like more granular control over multi-scene animations? Let us know in the comments below![/p][p]Thanks for your continued support and patience as we polish these features![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - UI & Cinematic Improvements
notes.notes:
Thanks to the valuable feedback from our community survey, we've implemented several important changes to improve your experience:
What's New:

Animation Pacing Controls - Added new "Pacing" settings in Preferences, giving you complete control over animation timing:

Standard (1.5s) - Default
Cinematic (3.5s) - For dramatic effect
Instant (no pause) - For speed runners
Director's Cut (10s) - The full cinematic experience


Improved UI Readability - Increased menu label font sizes from 16 to 22 for better visibility and accessibility
Day 1 Animation Fixes - Resolved multiple animation timing and transition issues in the opening chapter

Based on Your Feedback:
Your survey responses were eye-opening - 47.9% wanted MORE animations while 31.3% felt there were too many. Rather than pick a side, we've given everyone what they want:

Removed repetitive car animations that interrupted story flow
Polish pass on existing animations for smoother transitions
Full player control - YOU decide the pacing that works for you

Coming Soon:

Additional animation refinements
Further UI improvements
More accessibility options

The split in feedback showed us there's no one-size-fits-all approach. That's why we've focused on customization - letting you tailor the experience to your preferences.
Thank you for your continued support and honest feedback. Keep it coming!

notes.title: Post-Launch Thoughts - Learning from Our First Release
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Three days since launch, wanted to share some thoughts on what we've learned bringing the first AI-polished AVN to Steam.
[/p][p][b]The Price[/b] - We get it. $16 in this economy hits different. Between 300 hours of AI processing, custom models, and positioning this as premium content... plus you're getting Episodes 2 & 3 included. Still, we hear you.
[/p][p][b]"Should've been Early Access"[/b] - Quick clarification: Steam doesn't allow EA for adult games anymore unless you were already grandfathered in. We had to launch as a full episode.
[/p][p][b]"Where's the story?"[/b] - This is episode 1 of 3 in Season 1. Vlad, Andrei, Savannah - their backstories are coming. Some stories start slow before they explode. Use the feedback form (main menu or end of game) to tell us what you'd like to see.
[/p][p][b]Technical Issues[/b] - If you spot something weird (visual glitches, etc), screenshot it and send it over. We tested extensively but AI can be unpredictable sometimes despite our best efforts.
[/p][p]Quick shoutout - check out the game design elements we implemented. It was a heavy lift and not something you see often in AVNs.
[/p][p]We've gotten 40+ feedback form submissions already which is amazing. Keep them coming - this is how we improve.

[b]What's Working[/b] - The visual quality discussions have been amazing. Seeing players appreciate the cinematics and animation fluidity makes those 300 hours of processing worth it. Your screenshots are incredible - keep sharing them! 
[/p][p]1,708 players and counting. Episodes 2 & 3 are going to incorporate everything we're learning.[/p][p]Thanks for playing,

[b]P.S. - Speaking of Episode 2, here's a sneak peek at one of Sofia's outfits from Day 5. Yes, that's really her. And before anyone asks - we counted, she's got exactly 5 fingers on each hand.

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/4bd3ac79788e2fb89171f1871ec8e17b1cb68ede.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🌸 5 Days to Launch – Meet Sofia our MC
notes.notes:
[p]With just five days left until release, it is time to properly introduce you to the heart of our story: [b]Sofia Popescu[/b]. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/255134f1dc2041ab2e29baab5077933af362cc9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Sofia is a 35 year old real estate agent and rising influencer with nearly 200k followers. Born and raised in Los Angeles, she comes from a well to do family with her father a lawyer and her mother a model. From her mother she inherited elegance and stunning looks, but Sofia is more than appearances. She is kind yet independent, and while she can sometimes come across as a little arrogant, she will never allow herself to be stepped on or treated unfairly.
[/p][p]About five years ago she married [b]Vlad Popescu[/b], a Romanian immigrant whose direct humor and lack of pretense were a breath of fresh air compared to the shallow “perfect” men of her past. Vlad works in private equity, and while Sofia still loves him, his business of buying and dismantling companies has kept him distant. That distance is where our story begins.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/58682bd7413cbb3ee89a68b17415cd86ae91dcda.png"][/img][/p][p]Outside of work, Sofia is passionate about fitness and can easily run a 10k. She loves trying new restaurants and coffee shops, and above all, she has a weakness for a perfectly made latte. She owns her own 2.7 million dollar Los Angeles home (California prices, right?) and drives a beautiful AMG GT that she bought herself. Vlad paid for the custom green wrap that made the car uniquely hers. 
[/p][p]As the story unfolds, Sofia begins to look inward, reflecting on loneliness, visibility, and being truly seen for who she is. Her journey will test her independence, her desires, and the paths she chooses next.
[/p][p]✨ Fun fact: The Sofia you see today is actually the fourth iteration of her character, refined through player feedback and iteration until she became the stunning model you know now.
[/p][p]📸 All images you see here are taken directly from the game.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 📢 6 Days to Launch – How It All Started
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/0bd6f182329aaf1ee50df76f925e580f8c2bc30c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With just [b]6 days left[/b] until release on [b]September 11th[/b], we wanted to share how this project began.[/p][p]It started with a couple — [b]she is the Writer and he is the Product Designer[/b] — both award-winning photographers. What began as a playful [i][b]“what if we tried making something new?”[/b][/i] turned into a serious project. Early attempts with [b]generative AI alone failed,[/b] and working with [b]3D artists[/b] showed promise but not the quality we wanted.[/p][p]The real [b]breakthrough[/b] came late last year, when our [b]Blender artist[/b] finally hit the standard you now see in the game. Along the way we built [b]custom AI workflows to polish and enhance the visuals[/b], always keeping the artistry intact.[/p][p]The story has been carefully mapped into [b]15 planned episodes over 5 Seasons[/b]. We’ve already rewritten it once for cohesion, but the high-level vision hasn’t changed. Importantly, it is [b]written by a woman, from a woman’s perspective[/b], which gives Sofia’s voice and choices their depth.[/p][p]What began as a small idea is now a game built with [b]passion[/b], [b]persistence[/b], and the [b]desire to tell a different kind of story[/b] with the [b]best visuals[/b] we could achieve.[/p][p]💡 [b]Trivia:[/b] The very first storyboard was sketched on a coffee-stained notebook page — that draft eventually became the [b]15-episode roadmap[/b] we work from today.[/p][p]See you tomorrow for [b]Day 5[/b] of the countdown.[/p][p][/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/cf7a0f9046dab3a04898575ba3dab101163ee00d.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, which fuels our creativity and dedication. Stay tuned for more updates and let us know your thoughts on the new scenes!

notes.title: Steam Update: Release Delay for Episode 1 and Episode 2 Chapter 1
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Community,

We want to provide you with an important update regarding the release schedule of Episode 1 and Episode 2 Chapter 1 of our game. We've made the decision to delay the release to ensure that we meet the high standards we've set for our project. This delay allows us to incorporate significant improvements and ensure the gameplay experience is as immersive and polished as possible.

The decision to delay was not made lightly. We're implementing more detailed updates, extending scenes, and enhancing animations to enrich the narrative and visual experience. These enhancements take time, but we are confident they will offer a more satisfying and engaging game to our players.

For ongoing updates and a closer look at our development process, please consider visiting our Patreon
